label: Task
summary: Canonical Task artifact with bounded work and completion criteria.
task.schema.mismatch: Task validator was invoked for a non-task current schema.
task.title.missing: Task artifact should begin with a human-readable title.
task.objective.missing: Task body is missing the required Objective section.
task.doneCriteria.missing: Task body is missing the required Done Criteria section.
task.scope.missing: Task body is missing the required Scope section.
task.dependencies.missing: Task body is missing the required Dependencies section.
task.legacyShape.observed: Task body uses legacy browser-draft sections and is not the exact current canonical Task shape.
task.body.thin: Task body is thin; the bounded work request may be unclear.
task.body.canonical: Task body exposes the current canonical Objective, Done Criteria, Scope, and Dependencies sections.
task.legacyShape.incomplete: Legacy browser-draft compatibility is incomplete; required historical sections are missing.
task.legacyShape.readable: Historical browser-local Task draft remains readable and editable through the explicit compatibility boundary.
